401-1385-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1385-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

2228-4279-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-5931.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-5931.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

765-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

141-1893-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-3967.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3899-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3899-4302-4875.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost X or more life this turn.
4247-6972-7230.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cryptborn Horror.
When Cryptborn Horror dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3240-6462-6495-7396.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3240-6462-6495-7396.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3147-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

225-1479-5700-5701-7892.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1479-5700-5701-7892.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-7892.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4186-7687-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4186-7687-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-2999-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-2999-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vizier of Many Faces and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

5789-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5789-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
5789-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

1887-6575-7704--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Vorinclex and Doc Samson, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7510.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
6798-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-6798-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

240-5929-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-5929-6797.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1558-3257-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3257-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3372-4050-6006-7296.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-6006-7296.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

2478-2854-4574-6766.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2478-2854-4574-6766.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

38-2173-3845-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2957-3767-3918-4851.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-2732-6132.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

193-3604-4087.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Lavabrink Floodgates.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-4087.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1170-5733-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
1170-5733-6333.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

2178-2557-4660-5676.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
2178-2557-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2557-4660-5676.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

222-527-997-1753.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1636-2921-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2921-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6058.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1170-3821-6058.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Conviction by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Conviction spell.
Activate Conviction by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4067-4410-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Hermetic Study attached to Thieving Otter.
4067-4410-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

1770-2103-2788-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1770-2103-2788-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

674-1563-2206-4321-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Activate the two Food tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

296-3532-4985-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-4985-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1765-2279-2287-3581.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Spirit.
1765-2279-2287-3581.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other Spirit you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar twice by sacrificing the Spirit token and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {R}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

1902-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1902-1978-5056.description:
Cause Wirewood Channeler to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat from step 2.

2648-4659-5003.description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Triniform to Krark-Clan Ironworks to add {C}{C}.
Phyrexian Triniform and Nim Deathmantle both trigger.
Resolve Phyrexian Triniform's ability first, creating three Golem artifact creatures.
Sacrifice two Golems to Krark-Clan Ironworks to add 4 {C} total.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, paying the {4} to return Phyrexian Triniform to the battlefield with Nim Deathmantle equipped.
Repeat for infinite tokens and mana.

108-1912-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
